description_en: Queries the status of a collection rollback task
description_zh: 查询集合回档任务状态
name: QueryDBRestoreTaskStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service space
parameters.name: space_id

DetailMessage.description_en: The error message when the task fails
DetailMessage.description_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the backup file. This parameter is not empty only when the backup download task succeeds
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 备份文件下载链接，仅备份下载任务成功时非空

FailedCount.description_en: The number of database records that failed to be rolled back
FailedCount.description_zh: 回档失败的数据库记录数量

Phase.description_en:
The phase of the backup download task. Valid values:

PACKAGING: preparing the backup file.
UPLOADING: generating the downloadable file.
COMPLETED: preparation is complete.

This parameter can be empty during queuing or for rollback tasks
Phase.description_zh: 备份下载任务的阶段：PACKAGING 准备备份文件、UPLOADING 生成可下载文件、COMPLETED 准备完成。排队期间及回档任务可为空

Progress.description_en: The preparation progress of the backup download task. Value range: 0 to 100. This is not the browser file download progress. The value 0 is returned for legacy rollback tasks
Progress.description_zh: 备份下载任务准备进度，范围 0–100。不是浏览器文件下载进度；原有回档任务返回 0

Status.description_en:
The status of the rollback task. Valid values:

NEW: Newly created. This status does not apply to export tasks.
WAITING: Queued. This status may occur when there are many tasks.
RUNNING: Running.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
FAILED: Failed.

Stop polling when the task status changes to SUCCESS or FAILED
Status.description_zh:
回档任务状态。可选值如下：
NEW：新创建，导出任务不可能出现此状态。
WAITING：排队中，任务较多时可能会出现。
RUNNING：执行中。
SUCCESS：成功。
FAILED：失败。

注意任务状态变成SUCCESS或者FAILED都应该中止轮询

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of database records that are successfully rolled back
SuccessCount.description_zh: 成功回档的数据库记录数量
